name: Protective Flames
notes: 3/4/5s → ceil(3/5) = 1 turn. Converts 100% of all damage taken into healing for duration. Dispellable=false — this is his ultimate protective state. In engine: when this effect is active, every DamageEvent targeting Accursed is converted to a HealEvent instead. BALANCE RISK HIGH: effectively makes Accursed invulnerable + gaining HP equal to all attacks received for 1 full turn. damage_to_heal_pct is extension field.
